title: Social traffic, copy buttons per platform, Reddit/Quora answer helper
changes: CMS > Social posts > Social traffic: visits from Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Quora in the last 30 days, and which pages they opened (only numbers, nothing about the person)
Copy buttons per platform (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, TikTok bio, YouTube) for posting by hand: their links carry the platform so the visits are counted
Reddit & Quora answer helper: paste a question, get a helpful draft to read, edit and post by hand (no bots: both sites ban them)
Alert email when the guide writer publishes a guide, like news and blog posts
No RSS feed / Publer (taken out again): cli-social-feed.php --apply removes the feed rules if they were added
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/, unzip it, then run the installers listed in the deploy message.
